statement.zh: 考古综合将中尼罗库施表述为含凯尔迈青铜时代中心与其后纳帕塔—麦罗埃阶段的长序列（Edwards 2004；Welsby 1996）。
statement.en: Syntheses frame Middle Nile Kush as a long sequence including Kerma and later Napatan–Meroitic phases (Edwards 2004; Welsby 1996).
